name: @gesslar/lpc-language-tmgrammar-hl
description: TextMate grammar for LPC (Lars Pensjö C) syntax highlighting

scripts.sync-grammar: tag=$(gh api repos/jlchmura/lpc-language-server/releases/latest --jq .tag_name) && echo "Syncing grammar from $tag" && curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jlchmura/lpc-language-server/$tag/syntaxes/lpc.tmLanguage.json" -o lpc.tmLanguage.json
